tasks.spec:
python3 -u - <<'PY' > bedrock.txt 2>&1
import boto3
rt = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime", region_name="us-east-1")
for mid in ("us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0", "us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5"):
    try:
        r = rt.converse(modelId=mid, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [{"text": "Reply with the single word: ok"}]}], inferenceConfig={"maxTokens": 10})
        txt = r["output"]["message"]["content"][0]["text"].strip()[:40]
    except Exception as e:
        print("CONVERSE %s -> ERROR %s: %s" % (mid, type(e).__name__, str(e)[:250]))
    else:
        print("CONVERSE %s -> OK %r" % (mid, txt))
print("PROBE_DONE")
PY
rc=$?; cat bedrock.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: grep -q 'PROBE_DONE' bedrock.txt || { echo 'FAIL: probe did not finish'; exit 1; }; grep -qE '^CONVERSE us.anthropic.claude-haiku.* -> OK' bedrock.txt || { echo 'FAIL: admin profile cannot invoke Haiku on Bedrock:'; grep CONVERSE bedrock.txt; exit 1; }; echo 'PASS: admin profile invokes Bedrock:'; grep '^CONVERSE' bedrock.txt
tasks.verified: The admin AWS profile proven able to invoke Bedrock converse on Haiku (and Sonnet-5 attempted, result on record) before any eval spend.
